findings.title: New dashboard table discards query results
findings.description: When `use-table-widget-visualization` is enabled, every table receives empty columns, rows, and metadata regardless of `result`. Existing populated widgets therefore become empty. Pass the actual query results and column configuration, and test the feature-enabled path.

findings.title: Replay errors and breadcrumbs use different timestamp units
findings.description: Nodestore event timestamps are seconds, while recording timestamps are milliseconds. Comparing them directly places contemporary errors before the first breadcrumb, even when they occurred later. A focused execution reproduced this ordering error. Normalize both the comparison and generated log timestamps to one unit; test with realistic timestamps.

findings.title: Attribute query cache omits organization identity
findings.description: The request depends on `organization.slug`, but the cache key contains only query options. Two organizations using identical filters—for example, all projects and the same relative period—share a cache entry. Include organization identity in the key to prevent cross-organization attribute reuse.

findings.title: Hidden attributes remain visible without a search
findings.description: The empty-search branch returns before applying `HIDDEN_ATTRIBUTES`. Consequently, these attributes appear initially but disappear when users search for them. Apply the exclusion before the early return and test both search states.

findings.title: Timestamp validation checks truthiness instead of presence
findings.description: A report containing both `age: 0` and `timestamp: 0` passes validation, despite the explicit mutual-exclusion contract. Both fields can also be omitted. Validate their presence together at serializer level and add zero-value and missing-field tests.

findings.title: Custom renderers cannot intentionally return falsy content
findings.description: Both body and header rendering use `if (cell)` to select custom output. Valid results such as `0`, `''`, or `null` incorrectly invoke the fallback renderer. The documented fallback sentinel is `undefined`; check that explicitly and test falsy custom results.
